prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL high-quality game sprite atlas for ASHVEIL, a grounded melancholy post-apocalyptic dark fantasy world. The attached image is our OWN Ashhorn Stag identity atlas. Preserve this exact deer anatomy, antler structure, fur markings, proportions, rendering and camera in the new poses. No assets or pixels from any existing commercial game.

SUBJECT: one adult male Ashhorn Stag, 180kg, lean deep chest, long slender FOUR legs ending in split dark hooves, elegant deer muzzle, large deer ears, two branching ash-coated bone antlers with consistent moderate branching, short deer tail. Warm grey-brown short fur, darker dorsal ash, pale muted throat/rump, dark wet nose. Healthy living animal. No saddle, clothing, invented armor, glowing eyes, magic, skull face or wounds. High anatomical fidelity and rich hand-painted pixel clusters, defined restrained edges. Same camera as the reference: slightly elevated RPG view, enough top surface visible, never isometric tile rotation. Keep antlers, ears, face and all FOUR hooves fully in frame.

STRICT ATLAS: WIDE LANDSCAPE canvas, exactly FOUR rows by EIGHT columns = THIRTY-TWO separate complete figures. Equal cells with generous alpha-ZERO transparent gutters, no ground, floor, shadow, backdrop, text, labels or grid. Keep every full animal, all hooves and antlers/tusks fully inside its own cell, never touching neighbors or image edge. ONE CONSTANT FACING PER ROW: Row1 all face FRONT/toward viewer, nose toward bottom. Row2 all face LEFT, nose to left. Row3 all face RIGHT, nose to right. Row4 all face BACK/away, rump nearest bottom and head toward top; NEVER show a face or snout in the back row. The heading stays fixed even when the animal falls or lies down. Preserve the exact attached individual, body mass, markings, antler/tusk structure and restrained rendering.

This atlas has TWO actions per row. Columns1-4: quiet SLEEP loop of a living stag lying naturally with four legs folded and head resting safely, with subtle breathing/ear settle. All anatomy remains attached. Columns5-8: RISE from that resting pose: 5 lift head and chest, 6 extend forelegs and take weight, 7 straighten hind legs, 8 stand on FOUR hooves matching the attached idle. No jumping pop, human kneel, extra legs or changing facing. The deer antlers must fit above/beside the resting neck without penetrating the torso; boar tusks remain attached to the lower jaw. Row4 is a genuine back view of every resting/rising pose. Keep species identity, head scale and body proportions consistent across all32.
